title: 92% of Germans demand an emergency stop switch for AI systems, Bitkom survey finds
content_md:
92% of Germans demand an emergency stop switch for AI systems according to a Bitkom survey, because many consider the control and security of AI to be inadequate.

via Mastodon https://www.it-finanzmagazin.de/bitkom-umfrage-not-aus-schalter-fuer-alle-ki-systeme-253808/?fsp_sid=49996
